people.author: Learn.korean.edinburgh
people.evidenceQuote: Restaurant: 이거 주세요 (I'll have this, please)
people.excerpt:
You don't need fluent Korean for your trip. You need 3 phrases and the confidence to point at things. 🇰🇷

✈️ Airport: 화장실이 어디예요? (Where's the bathroom?)
🚕 Taxi: 여기로 가 주세요 (Take me here, please — show your phone!)
🍜 Restaurant: 이거 주세요 (I'll have this, please)

Say them out loud a few times before you land. That's genuinely all the prep you need.

Which one are you saving? Drop AIRPORT, TAXI, or RESTAURANT below 👇

Save this for your next trip — you'll want it at the airport, not in your camera roll from 6 months ago.

text:
My first trip to Seoul is booked for April, about ten days. I spent last night saving restaurants, then realized I couldn't tell which dishes were vegetarian. The subway map is still open in another tab.

I've kept up my Korean app lessons, but when I tried saying a simple order out loud, my mind went blank. Reading the answer is much easier than saying it. There's no room in my trip budget for tutoring. Most evenings I'm home after 7pm.
title: Plan Seoul trip
